quotes.quote: All bids submitted in response to Requests for Proposals (RFP’s) and Requests for Qualification (RFQ’s), documents contained within, and the details outlined on those documents become public record upon receipt by the City Clerk’s office and opening at the corresponding Board of Contract and Supply (BOCS) meeting.

If sensitive information that has not been requested is enclosed or if a bidder opts to enclose the defined supplemental information prior to the issuing department’s request in the bidding packet submitted to the City Clerk, the City of Providence has no obligation to redact those details and bears no liability associated with the information becoming public record.
Bidders who make such an attempt will be disqualified.

findings.title: Potential Conflict Between Bid Form and Standard Terms on Payment Terms
findings.fact: The bid form states that awards will be made within 90 days and all bid prices are firm, while the standard terms state invoices are payable 60 days from receipt. There is no direct contradiction, but the 90-day award period may affect payment timing.
findings.business_implication: The bidder should be aware that payment may be delayed up to 60 days after invoicing, and the award may take up to 90 days, affecting cash flow.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for potential delays in payment and award.

quotes.quote: Awards will be made within nighty (90) days of bid opening. All bid prices will be considered firm, unless qualified otherwise.
Invoices submitted to the City shall be payable sixty (60) days from the time of receipt by the City.

findings.title: Insurance Requirements Not Specified
findings.fact: The standard terms require the contractor to maintain insurance coverage required by the RFP or commercially reasonable coverage, but the specific types and amounts are not stated in the provided pages.
findings.business_implication: The bidder cannot determine the exact insurance costs and requirements from the document, which may affect pricing and risk assessment.
findings.action_recommendation: Request clarification on the specific insurance requirements, including types and coverage limits.
